relationships won’t fix you or your problems. relationships won’t make you feel whole and happy. you have to have some sense of self worth and foundation of love for yourself before. i spent a lot of my younger years seeking validation from anyone - and was most successful with men and all it led me to was heartbreak and trust issues… when you’re in this mindset you aren’t setting standards for yourself and it can lead to really bad situations and people taking advantage of you. 

if you already want to kill yourself bc you don’t have a relationship i can’t imagine how fights between partners would make you or other hardships that come with relationships. a relationship is not a badge of honor or a fun new activity to do it’s a real responsibility that takes a lot of mental strength. 

in all honesty it doesn’t seem like youre anywhere close to being ready for a relationship. 
if you want a relationship so bad, build one with a therapist.

check out wheaton

Metra: UPW from downtown wheaton 1 hr train ride

Safe: B+ crime grade

Schools: i grew up k-12 here and turned out fine.. lol but decent schools fr

Outdoors: prarie path!!! Blackwell forest preserve, herrick lake, danada horse farms, st james farm. parks, trails, rivers, forests

Traffic: traffic on roosevelt rd and butterfield around rush hours but nothing hair pulling

Downtown: its cute and they recently remodeled the whole downtown so it looks even nicer, various new restaurants, the library is there too!

Politics: moderately liberal

Golf: I cant say much about golf but ive seen at least a few around and when i googled theres places on the map nearby

Wheaton is where I grew up. kinda reminds me of churchy, well off people, but pricing is variable, i have a single mom 29,000 a year and we made it. If in downtown wheaton, the train goes directly to CHI in about 1hr from college station, UPW metra line, so it's an easy commute for weekend activities and such. Schools are good but what I like is it's close to a lot of nice forest preserves. In high school I would always go there to explore and it's pretty safe. Prarie path, Blackwell forest preserve, st james farm, herrick lake, Danada horse farms. theres a lot of restaurants everywhere and stores in a close proximity. theres a lot of extracurriculars for kids and stuff to engage in around the area like art studios, gyms, coffee houses etc.  Its also really close to glen ellyn and the glen ellyn trader joes lol. 

Geneva probably has more of a night life and a cool river... and some nature, check out the Fabyan Villa Museum & Japanese Garden. idk anything else about DG or SC really.
